compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: In the second year the cloud lifts, tribal divisions move in order, Moses speaks with Hobab, the ark goes ahead, and departure and rest receive spoken appeals.
observations.label: The cloud lifts and Israel departs Sinai

observations.body: The cloud lifts and Israel departs Sinai belongs to sinai remembered in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Numbers 10:11–36 supplies later-memory evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Numbers 10:11–36 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: The cloud lifts and Israel departs Sinai belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
payload.title: The cloud lifts and Israel departs Sinai
